criteria.statement: The classifier produces deterministic classifications from sanitized read-only input and exposes no mutation path.
A single authoritative identity match produces an explicit operator-review plan that preserves existing identity evidence.
No match, name-only similarity, and container-name mismatch behavior follow the documented fail-closed matching policy.
Multiple authoritative candidates or conflicting trusted Souls halt adoption classification with a stable reason code and non-zero CLI status.
The report does not authorize re-adoption, key lifecycle operations, ACL/grant changes, custody changes, Bahia service changes, or event publication.
